title: a project that never adopted JITSO gets warnings for the hook and the instructions, an ok for the optional skill, and no failure
source: intended: B4B5-DESIGN.md B4-22 and the doctor spec (defect N-20): a read-only health check
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-20, B4.5). On the default project (a catalog, no hook, no skill, no instruction block) doctor exits 0: `warn hooks: not registered: the owner's own session in this project is not guarded (run jitso setup hook --scope user)`, `ok   hooks-user: not registered ... (optional ...)`, `ok   skill-project: not installed (optional: ...)`, `warn instructions: ...`, `ok   catalog: ...`, and not one `fail` line. A warning never breaks a script.

stdout.regex: (?m)^warn hooks: not registered: the owner's own session in this project is not guarded \(run jitso setup hook --scope user\)$
(?m)^ok   hooks-user: not registered in ~/\.claude/settings\.json \(optional: run jitso setup hook --scope user to guard your own session\)$
